# Frame Inventory Implementation Plan

## Overview

Build an OOH frame inventory management system with:
- **Backend**: Spring Boot 3.5 + Java 21 + MongoDB
- **Frontend**: React 19 + TypeScript + Vite
- **Features**: Add/Edit frames, CSV bulk upload, View history

---

## 1. High-Level Implementation Plan

### Phase 1: Backend Foundation
1. Add MongoDB dependencies to `build.gradle`
2. Configure MongoDB connection in `application.yml`
3. Create Frame document entity with simplified domain model
4. Create FrameHistory embedded document for audit trail
5. Create FrameRepository (MongoRepository)

### Phase 2: Backend API
6. Create FrameController with REST endpoints:
   - `GET /api/frames` - List all frames (paginated)
   - `GET /api/frames/{id}` - Get single frame with history
   - `POST /api/frames` - Create new frame
   - `PUT /api/frames/{id}` - Update frame (auto-records history)
   - `POST /api/frames/upload` - Bulk CSV upload
7. Create FrameService for business logic
8. Create CsvParserService for CSV processing
9. Add validation (Bean Validation)

### Phase 3: Frontend Foundation
10. Set up project structure (pages, components, api)
11. Copy design system tokens and styles
12. Create API client utilities
13. Create shared components (Table, Form fields, Status chips)

### Phase 4: Frontend Features
14. Frame list page with search/filter
15. Frame detail view
16. Add frame form
17. Edit frame form
18. History timeline view
19. CSV upload component

### Phase 5: Polish & Testing
20. Add basic error handling
21. Write key unit tests
22. Update README with design decisions

---

## 2. Recommended PR Sequence

| PR # | Title | Scope |
|------|-------|-------|
| 1 | `feat: Add MongoDB Frame entity and repository` | Backend: entity, repository, MongoDB config |
| 2 | `feat: Add Frame CRUD REST endpoints` | Backend: controller, service, validation |
| 3 | `feat: Add CSV bulk upload endpoint` | Backend: CSV parsing, bulk insert |
| 4 | `feat: Add frame history tracking` | Backend: audit trail on updates |
| 5 | `feat: Add frontend project structure and design tokens` | Frontend: setup, tokens, shared components |
| 6 | `feat: Add frame list page` | Frontend: list view with table |
| 7 | `feat: Add frame detail and history views` | Frontend: detail page, history timeline |
| 8 | `feat: Add frame create/edit forms` | Frontend: form components |
| 9 | `feat: Add CSV upload UI` | Frontend: file upload component |
| 10 | `chore: Add tests and update documentation` | Tests, README updates |

---

## 3. Backend Architecture

```
src/backend/src/main/java/com/global/ct/frameinventory/
├── Application.java                 # Existing entry point
├── HealthController.java            # Existing health endpoint
│
├── frame/
│   ├── Frame.java                   # MongoDB document entity (also used as API response)
│   ├── FrameHistory.java            # Embedded history entry
│   ├── FrameStatus.java             # Enum: LIVE, PENDING, MAINTENANCE, BLOCKED, DRAFT
│   ├── FrameRepository.java         # MongoRepository interface
│   ├── FrameService.java            # Business logic
│   ├── FrameController.java         # REST endpoints
│   └── FrameRequest.java            # Create/Update request body (input only)
│
├── csv/
│   └── CsvParserService.java        # CSV parsing with OpenCSV
│
└── config/
    └── MongoConfig.java             # MongoDB auditing config (optional)
```

**Key Design Decisions:**
- Single `frame` package for all frame-related code (avoid premature abstraction)
- History embedded in Frame document (no separate collection needed)
- Use OpenCSV for CSV parsing (simple, well-maintained)
- `FrameRequest` for input (create/update) — explicit contract for what clients can set
- `Frame` entity returned directly as response — no separate response DTO needed

---

## 4. Frontend Architecture

```
src/frontend/src/
├── main.tsx                         # Entry point
├── App.tsx                          # Router setup
├── index.css                        # Global styles
│
├── api/
│   └── frames.ts                    # API client functions
│
├── pages/
│   ├── FrameListPage.tsx            # Main list view
│   ├── FrameDetailPage.tsx          # Single frame detail + history
│   ├── FrameFormPage.tsx            # Create/edit form
│   └── CsvUploadPage.tsx            # Bulk upload
│
├── components/
│   ├── layout/
│   │   ├── Shell.tsx                # App shell (nav, header)
│   │   └── PageHeader.tsx           # Page title + breadcrumbs
│   │
│   ├── frames/
│   │   ├── FrameTable.tsx           # Data table component
│   │   ├── FrameForm.tsx            # Form fields component
│   │   ├── FrameStatusChip.tsx      # Status badge
│   │   └── FrameHistoryTimeline.tsx # Audit trail display
│   │
│   └── shared/
│       ├── Button.tsx               # Styled button
│       ├── Input.tsx                # Form input
│       ├── Select.tsx               # Dropdown
│       └── FileUpload.tsx           # File input
│
├── hooks/
│   └── useFrames.ts                 # Data fetching hooks
│
├── types/
│   └── frame.ts                     # TypeScript interfaces
│
└── styles/
    ├── tokens.css                   # Design system tokens (copy from design-system/)
    └── components.css               # Component styles (copy from design-system/)
```

**Key Design Decisions:**
- Use React Router for navigation
- Fetch API (no additional HTTP library needed)
- No state management library (React state + props sufficient for this scope)
- Copy design system CSS directly (avoid build complexity)

# Frame Inventory Implementation Plan

## Overview

Build an OOH frame inventory management system with:
- **Backend**: Spring Boot 3.5 + Java 21 + MongoDB
- **Frontend**: React 19 + TypeScript + Vite
- **Features**: Add/Edit frames, CSV bulk upload, View history

---

## 1. High-Level Implementation Plan

### Phase 1: Backend Foundation
1. Add MongoDB dependencies to `build.gradle`
2. Configure MongoDB connection in `application.yml`
3. Create Frame document entity with simplified domain model
4. Create FrameHistory embedded document for audit trail
5. Create FrameRepository (MongoRepository)

### Phase 2: Backend API
6. Create FrameController with REST endpoints:
   - `GET /api/frames` - List all frames (paginated)
   - `GET /api/frames/{id}` - Get single frame with history
   - `POST /api/frames` - Create new frame
   - `PUT /api/frames/{id}` - Update frame (auto-records history)
   - `POST /api/frames/upload` - Bulk CSV upload
7. Create FrameService for business logic
8. Create CsvParserService for CSV processing
9. Add validation (Bean Validation)

### Phase 3: Frontend Foundation
10. Set up project structure (pages, components, api)
11. Copy design system tokens and styles
12. Create API client utilities
13. Create shared components (Table, Form fields, Status chips)

### Phase 4: Frontend Features
14. Frame list page with search/filter
15. Frame detail view
16. Add frame form
17. Edit frame form
18. History timeline view
19. CSV upload component

### Phase 5: Polish & Testing
20. Add basic error handling
21. Write key unit tests
22. Update README with design decisions

---

## 2. Recommended PR Sequence

| PR # | Title | Scope |
|------|-------|-------|
| 1 | `feat: Add MongoDB Frame entity and repository` | Backend: entity, repository, MongoDB config |
| 2 | `feat: Add Frame CRUD REST endpoints` | Backend: controller, service, validation |
| 3 | `feat: Add CSV bulk upload endpoint` | Backend: CSV parsing, bulk insert |
| 4 | `feat: Add frame history tracking` | Backend: audit trail on updates |
| 5 | `feat: Add frontend project structure and design tokens` | Frontend: setup, tokens, shared components |
| 6 | `feat: Add frame list page` | Frontend: list view with table |
| 7 | `feat: Add frame detail and history views` | Frontend: detail page, history timeline |
| 8 | `feat: Add frame create/edit forms` | Frontend: form components |
| 9 | `feat: Add CSV upload UI` | Frontend: file upload component |
| 10 | `chore: Add tests and update documentation` | Tests, README updates |

---

## 3. Backend Architecture

```
src/backend/src/main/java/com/global/ct/frameinventory/
├── Application.java                 # Existing entry point
├── HealthController.java            # Existing health endpoint
│
├── frame/
│   ├── Frame.java                   # MongoDB document entity (also used as API response)
│   ├── FrameHistory.java            # Embedded history entry
│   ├── FrameStatus.java             # Enum: LIVE, PENDING, MAINTENANCE, BLOCKED, DRAFT
│   ├── FrameRepository.java         # MongoRepository interface
│   ├── FrameService.java            # Business logic
│   ├── FrameController.java         # REST endpoints
│   └── FrameRequest.java            # Create/Update request body (input only)
│
├── csv/
│   └── CsvParserService.java        # CSV parsing with OpenCSV
│
└── config/
    └── MongoConfig.java             # MongoDB auditing config (optional)
```

**Key Design Decisions:**
- Single `frame` package for all frame-related code (avoid premature abstraction)
- History embedded in Frame document (no separate collection needed)
- Use OpenCSV for CSV parsing (simple, well-maintained)
- `FrameRequest` for input (create/update) — explicit contract for what clients can set
- `Frame` entity returned directly as response — no separate response DTO needed

---

## 4. Frontend Architecture

```
src/frontend/src/
├── main.tsx                         # Entry point
├── App.tsx                          # Router setup
├── index.css                        # Global styles
│
├── api/
│   └── frames.ts                    # API client functions
│
├── pages/
│   ├── FrameListPage.tsx            # Main list view
│   ├── FrameDetailPage.tsx          # Single frame detail + history
│   ├── FrameFormPage.tsx            # Create/edit form
│   └── CsvUploadPage.tsx            # Bulk upload
│
├── components/
│   ├── layout/
│   │   ├── Shell.tsx                # App shell (nav, header)
│   │   └── PageHeader.tsx           # Page title + breadcrumbs
│   │
│   ├── frames/
│   │   ├── FrameTable.tsx           # Data table component
│   │   ├── FrameForm.tsx            # Form fields component
│   │   ├── FrameStatusChip.tsx      # Status badge
│   │   └── FrameHistoryTimeline.tsx # Audit trail display
│   │
│   └── shared/
│       ├── Button.tsx               # Styled button
│       ├── Input.tsx                # Form input
│       ├── Select.tsx               # Dropdown
│       └── FileUpload.tsx           # File input
│
├── hooks/
│   └── useFrames.ts                 # Data fetching hooks
│
├── types/
│   └── frame.ts                     # TypeScript interfaces
│
└── styles/
    ├── tokens.css                   # Design system tokens (copy from design-system/)
    └── components.css               # Component styles (copy from design-system/)
```

**Key Design Decisions:**
- Use React Router for navigation
- Fetch API (no additional HTTP library needed)
- No state management library (React state + props sufficient for this scope)
- Copy design system CSS directly (avoid build complexity)

---

## 5. MongoDB Document Structure

### Frame Document

```javascript
{
  "_id": ObjectId("..."),
  "frameId": "1234604983",           // Business ID from CSV

  // Classification
  "type": "DIGITAL",                 // DIGITAL or CLASSIC
  "format": "DIGITAL_CROSSTRACK_48_SHEETS",
  "environment": "UNDERGROUND",      // UNDERGROUND, STATION, ROADSIDE, AIRPORT, MALL, BUS_SHELTER
  "status": "LIVE",                  // LIVE, PENDING, MAINTENANCE, BLOCKED, DRAFT
  "statusReason": null,

  // Location
  "location": {
    "address": "VICTORIA LINE PLATFORM 4 SOUTHBOUND",
    "town": "London West End",
    "region": "London",
    "countryCode": "UK",
    "postcode": "W1J 9DZ",
    "postcodeArea": "W",
    "postcodeDistrict": "1J",
    "latitude": 51.50604991,
    "longitude": -0.14174505,
    "distanceToClosestSchool": 637
  },

  // Site
  "site": {
    "siteNo": "GRPX04033",
    "inventorySiteNo": "3776",
    "station": "Green Park",
    "airport": null,
    "panelNumber": "01"
  },

  // Format details
  "formatDetails": {
    "sizeCode": "DX48",
    "sizeGroupCode": "DX48",
    "tSize": "LARGE",
    "aspectRatioCode": "DX48",
    "pixelWidth": 1920,
    "pixelHeight": 1200,
    "illuminationTypeId": 1,
    "numberOfSlots": 6
  },

  // Commercial
  "commercial": {
    "impactWeight": 0.6027,
    "premium": false,
    "pricingGrade": null,
    "priceEntityId": "LUDX48",
    "productionRateCard": null,
    "productionRateCardLegacy": null
  },

  // External IDs
  "externalIds": {
    "broadsignDisplayUnitId": "62570424",
    "broadsignFrameId": null,
    "broadsignDomainId": "5123640",
    "linkedFrameIds": null,
    "locationId": "w1j9dz"
  },

  // Timestamps
  "createdDate": ISODate("2022-10-01T16:26:27Z"),
  "modifiedDate": ISODate("2026-05-11T22:18:05Z"),

  // Audit history (embedded)
  "history": [
    {
      "timestamp": ISODate("2026-05-11T22:18:05Z"),
      "action": "UPDATE",
      "user": "system",                // Or actual user if auth implemented
      "changes": [
        {
          "field": "status",
          "oldValue": "PENDING",
          "newValue": "LIVE"
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "timestamp": ISODate("2022-10-01T16:26:27Z"),
      "action": "CREATE",
      "user": "csv-import",
      "changes": []
    }
  ]
}
```

**Design Rationale:**
- **Embedded history**: Keeps related data together, simplifies queries
- **Nested objects**: Groups related fields logically (location, site, format, commercial)
- **Business ID separate from MongoDB `_id`**: Preserves original frame_id for reference
- **Index on**: `frameId` (unique), `status`, `environment`, `location.town`

---
